editorial.blurb: A casual, smoky spot where the owner greets you personally and serves some of the neighborhood's most authentic, generously portioned Mexican fare.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the al pastor and guisado de res tacos—reviewers rave about these the most—and save room for the rice and beans, which many call the best they've ever had. Cash only, and arrive early to avoid the crowds.

topDishes.note: Excellent flavor, up there with the best in the neighborhood
Possibly the best many reviewers have ever had
